en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Ja’far bin Muhammed bin Masrur, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Hussain bin Muhammed bin ‘Amer, from his paternal uncle, Abdullah bin ‘Amer, from Muhammed bin Abi Umayr, from Jameel bin Saleh, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:

A complaint is only that you say: «Verily, I have been afflicted with what none has been afflicted with» or that you say: «Verily, it has hit me what has not hit anyone». A complaint is not that you say: «I remained awake yesterday» and «I had a fever today» and similar to this.
